about: Blue Jay Gold Corp. engages in the acquisition and exploration of mineral properties in Canada. The company explores for gold, silver, and base metal deposits. Its flagship assets are the 100%-owned Steller gold project, which consists of the Skukum Creek deposit, the Goddell Gully deposit, the past-producing Mt. Skukum gold mine, and a range of gold-silver showings covering a total area of 17,030 hectares located in southern Yukon; and the 100%-owned Pichette-Clist gold project, which consists of the Pichette claims and the Clist claims covering an area of 3,600 hectares situated in the Geraldton-Beardmore Greenstone Belt of Northwestern Ontario. Blue Jay Gold Corp. was incorporated in 2023 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
